caption: The drawing depicts a single wooden chair with a straight back composed of five vertical slats framed by two thicker vertical posts and a horizontal top rail. The wood appears to be a reddish-brown color with visible grain patterns. The seat is rectangular and upholstered with a dark blue fabric featuring a subtle, intricate floral or damask-style pattern. The chair has four straight legs joined by horizontal stretchers on all sides near the bottom. The background is a plain, light beige color with a faint rectangular border framing the entire composition. There is a signature in the bottom left corner of the drawing.
title: Side Chair
